policy: Owner-approved public retail package prices are applied exactly; no prices are inferred or reinterpreted.

governance.pricingSourceScope: The approved pricing CSV governs only products and package schedules explicitly represented in it.
governance.productsAbsentFromPricingSource: Products absent from the approved pricing CSV retain their separately approved commercial schedules; absence does not revoke or replace those schedules.
